newsitem.title: USA: Ross Stores Oct same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Ross Stores Oct same-store sales rise.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc Thursday said sales for the four week period ended November 2 rose 23 percent to $132 million from $107 million. Comparable store sales for the same period increased 17 percent on a day-for-day basis from the prior year.

For the 13 weeks ended November 2, sales rose 21 percent to $403 million from $333 million. Comparable store sales for the third quarter increased 14 percent on a day-for-day basis from the prior year.

For the nine months ended November 2, sales totaled $1.18 billion, a 19 percent increase from the $991 million. Same store sales for the first nine months of 1996 increased 12 percent on a day-for-day basis from the prior year.
